name: @tellma/locale-ar
description: Arabic locale pack for Tellma distributions — library strings (Transloco scope) plus the self-hosted Noto Sans Arabic font subset.

Born at 0.41 KB measured: provideTellmaLocaleAr and tmArabic, which loads the strings entry point with import().
budgetNotes../strings: Born at 6.39 KB measured: the component library's Arabic and the platform's Arabic table. An app loads it on the first switch to Arabic, never in its initial bundle. Raised from 6.5 to 7 for the typed values' Arabic strings: measured 6.47 before and 6.59 after (+0.12 KB), the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the tm.value block (Yes and No, the file label, the file picker's label with its gendered imperative, and the too-large, wrong-type and upload-failed errors).
budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
